svg.title: M13: Judge selection, case publication and evidence inspection
svg.desc: The judge chooses a control, scope and fresh, replay or offline profile. M13 pins authorized inputs and runs the chosen workflow. A case separates requirement result, evidence and analysis states, shows rule and revision context, and lets the judge inspect calculations and raw sources. The displayed10800-token breach is illustrative.

g.text: M13 / JUDGE QUERY / ILLUSTRATIVE DESIGN — NO LIVE CASE
Select the scope. Inspect the result. Follow the evidence.
Runnable CLI baseline • optional UI uses the same query and assessment contracts

g.text: Judge selection: Control 16 / Run FM-B

g.title: Host preserves exact scope, source and accepted inputs throughout the chosen workflow
g.text: M13 host: authorize → pin inputs → run selected profile → publish coherently
Complete control populations • original query deadline • durable query/stage recovery
C9 resolves full applicable windows. Replaying a case does not imply a fresh model execution.

g.text: Open the evidence

g.title: Official two-minute retrieval and proposed one-minute fresh case are different claims
g.text: Official: answer + records within 2 minutes. Proposed fresh case: ≤60 seconds, unmeasured.
